label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said what is expected of you is unclear. What is happening?
Every country team emails me saying their invoices are urgent. Without a clear priority order from my lead, I waste time asking around and sometimes miss my daily quota by about 20 invoices.
What would help you prioritize the urgent invoices from the country teams?
A simple priority order from my lead or having one designated person who decides would help. That way I wouldn't waste time asking around and could hit my daily quota.
